summary.headline: Judging Event Timing
summary.text: Astrological instructions for judging the durability and timing of an event: assess planets in the four angles, their conjunctions and receptions, the lord of the ascendant, the Moon, the lord of the Midheaven, applying degrees as days, and the strength of angular, succedent, and other places.
